title: Bibliometric maps of three research fields
question: How are these fields growing, what are their themes and where are the gaps?
headline: Trade credit and SMEs: 29 articles a year in 2021-2025 (17 in 2011-2015); Ownership and boards: 189 articles a year in 2021-2025 (116 in 2011-2015); AI, automation and labour costs: 273 articles a year in 2021-2025 (29 in 2011-2015).
